about: Design projections for T17 from ledger LF-1/LF-2, not observed provider balances. Unit tests load these records unchanged. Values are USD minor units. A tile shows the API number and opens its API-supplied calculation; the browser never derives S, P or K_p.

expect.coverage: USD 40,000.00 minimum projected cash / USD 30,000.00 floor

expect.calculation: 70,000.00 settled - 50,000.00 payroll = 20,000.00; delayed receipt and t=48 withdrawal excluded at t=40

expect.reason: Balance authority reduced; refresh observed evidence before funding

layout.desktop: Navigation at left; answer strip above account/deadline details; calculation opens inline
layout.phone: Screen title and mode first, answer strip stacked, labelled navigation wraps without a hidden essential action
layout.dates: Show absolute UTC and separately labelled browser-local time; countdown is additional, never the only deadline
